run_omol_benchmark: run an OMolRunner benchmark calculation on a chunk of input structures using an ASE calculator
write_omol_results: write OMolRunner calculation results to a gzip compressed JSON file in the results directory
init_omol_runner: initialize an OMolRunner with an ASE calculator, pickle input data, benchmark name, and benchmark callable
split_omol_jobs: split OMolRunner input data into chunks for parallel array job processing across multiple workers
checkpoint_omol_state: save the OMolRunner checkpoint state to a specified location for preemption recovery
